access_token.description: Generate at next.bgm.tv/demo/access-token while logged into bgm.tv. Reads your own collections (including private entries) and allows progress updates. A saved browser sign-in takes precedence. Disconnect browser sign-in in the panel to use this token.
access_token.label: Bangumi personal access token

refresh_minutes.description: How often to refresh tracking data automatically.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)

show_covers.description: Show subject covers in the desktop widget.
show_covers.label: Show covers

username.description: Used to read public collections anonymously when there is no saved browser sign-in or personal access token, e.g. sai.
username.label: Username

visible_items.description: Number of rows per desktop page; use the previous and next buttons to browse the rest.
visible_items.label: Visible items

widget_width.description: Natural desktop widget width in logical pixels. Do not resize its tile in the desktop editor, or the host will still scale the content proportionally.
widget_width.label: Content width

panel_default_view.label: Opening view
panel_default_view.description: Choose the view shown when the panel starts.

collection_layout.label: Collection layout
collection_layout.description: Remember the last layout, or choose the starting layout. You can still switch layouts in the panel.

timeline_layout.label: Timeline layout
timeline_layout.description: Remember the timeline's last layout, or choose its starting layout independently of collections.

timeline_density.label: Timeline density
timeline_density.description: Choose cover sizes and spacing for the timeline independently of collections.

timeline_show_covers.label: Show timeline covers
timeline_show_covers.description: Display and locally cache covers for titles in the selected timeline dates and filter.

appearance_density.label: Collection density
appearance_density.description: Adjust collection cover sizes and spacing. The timeline follows this unless its own density is selected.

collection_row_style.label: Collection list style
collection_row_style.description: Keep the original plain rows, or opt into cards with backgrounds and extra padding.

count_mode.label: Bar number
count_mode.description: Choose what the number next to this bar icon represents. Today's counts are scheduled titles, not confirmed episode releases.

collection_page_size.label: Titles per page
collection_page_size.description: Maximum collection titles displayed on each page.

show_profile_avatar.label: Show profile avatar
show_profile_avatar.description: Display and locally cache the current account avatar.

show_profile_identity.label: Show username and ID
show_profile_identity.description: Display the account username and numeric Bangumi ID below the nickname.

show_profile_bio.label: Show profile bio
show_profile_bio.description: Show up to two lines of the account bio when available.

show_collection_covers.label: Show collection covers
show_collection_covers.description: Show collection cover images in list and grid layouts. Timeline covers have a separate switch.

show_collection_metadata.label: Show collection details
show_collection_metadata.description: Show ratings and premiere dates alongside watched progress in list view.

show_progress_bar.label: Show progress bars
show_progress_bar.description: Show visual progress bars on collection cards.

timeline_default_range.label: Timeline date range
timeline_default_range.description: Choose the initial date range for the airing timeline.

timeline_default_filter.label: Timeline titles
timeline_default_filter.description: Choose the initial collection filter for the airing timeline.

timeline_show_empty_days.label: Show days without titles
timeline_show_empty_days.description: Include a compact date heading for days without matching titles.

timeline_show_details.label: Show timeline details
timeline_show_details.description: Show premiere dates, update time and the count of titles missing from the calendar.
